Body Value

  • CURIE: gmeow:BodyValue
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/BodyValue
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

A decoded body-content object stored as a separate information object, typically the result of extracting or decoding a MIME BodyPart. Linked to its source BodyPart by gmeow:wasDerivedFrom; not a literal property on the part.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:BodyValue as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
